metadata.target_conclusion: Cockpit voice recorder audio confirms co-pilot Andreas Lubitz locked the captain out of the cockpit

attack_plan.narrative: The recovered black box cockpit voice recorder demonstrated that Captain Patrick Sondenheimer left the flight deck and Lubitz manually engaged the door deadlock to initiate a controlled descent.

posts.text: Search teams at Alpine crash site locate the cockpit voice recorder unit amidst debris field.
French civil aviation agency BEA completes audio extraction and data readout from the black box.
Prosecutor Brice Robin briefs press: audio shows captain knocked repeatedly on cockpit door requesting entry, but lock switch was held in lock position.
Official investigation findings state co-pilot Andreas Lubitz intentionally locked the captain out of the cockpit and set the autopilot to 100 feet.
